title: Counting Under Disagreement: Dollar-Weighted Measurement, Selective Machine Labelling and Budgeted Human Review from Disagreeing AI Readers of Administrative Text
abstract: arXiv:2611.13215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study AI-assisted measurement when one text label applies to many administrative records, the target is a monetary total, and the human readings that anchor the machines disagree. The testbed is 121,070 grant-purpose texts from US tax filings (799,675 records, \$126.4B), labelled by a rule-based classifier and three language models, with a designed sample of 651 texts read independently by three people under one codebook. We state exact conditions for a fixed-predictor difference estimator and for a cross-fitted predictor whose folds are assigned to the whole frame before sampling, under Poisson sampling, and assess the implemented fixed-size procedures by simulation: 8 predictors whose own totals span \$11.2-15.0B agree to within \$0.4B once rectified. Two rules that accept machine labels at a stated dollar-weighted error, weighted conformal p-values under a dollar measure and Learn-then-Test on the design estimate of the error, are

translated_title: 在分歧中计数：基于存在分歧的行政文本AI阅读者的美元加权测量、选择性机器标注与预算化人工复核
translated_abstract: 我们研究AI辅助测量问题，其场景是：一个文本标签需应用于大量行政记录，测量目标为货币总额，而用于校准机器的人工阅读结果本身存在分歧。测试平台来自美国税务申报中的121,070条拨款用途文本（共799,675条记录，总额1264亿美元），由一个基于规则的分类器和三个语言模型进行标注；同时按设计方案抽取651条文本，由三人在同一编码手册下独立阅读。我们在泊松抽样下给出了固定预测变量差分估计量、以及交叉拟合预测变量（其折在抽样前即分配至整个抽样框）的精确条件，并通过仿真评估所实现的固定样本量程序：8个预测变量自身总额介于112亿至150亿美元之间，经校正后相互差异在4亿美元以内。两种按规定的美元加权误差接受机器标签的规则——美元度量下的加权保形p值方法，以及基于误差设计估计的Learn-then-Test方法——（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对多个AI阅读者对行政文本标注存在分歧、且测量目标为货币总额的场景，本文提出了融合选择性机器标注与预算化人工复核的美元加权估计框架，在可控美元加权误差下实现对总额的准确测量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dollar-weighted measurement framework combining selective machine labelling and budgeted human review, enabling accurate estimation of monetary totals from administrative text when anchoring AI readers disagree, with provable error control.
